title: Deploys start by themselves in production
quote: production starts the deploy automatically, as today: the moment a change lands in production.
means: theOS's deploy starts by itself the moment a change lands in production and its release is green; it runs only from production. avenMAIA read your "from production" as by hand; this corrects it.

supersedes.what: D-60's "started by hand": the deploy starts by itself when a change lands in production.
